title: Concept: pip configuration points at a cleartext index
description: pip.conf declares a `pip.conf` index URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every artifact and hash comparison crosses the network unencrypted, so a substitution is invisible.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pip.conf (pypi).
risk: Every artifact and hash comparison crosses the network unencrypted, so a substitution is invisible.
